result.stdout:
log2 — Log Control Plane CLI

Usage:
  log2                          Connect to auto-discovered local instance
  log2 --pid 1234               Connect to specific local process
  log2 --remote host:port       Connect to remote instance
  log2 --command "status"       Execute single command and exit
  log2 --discover               List running Log instances

Options:
  -l, --local             Local connection via UDS (default)
  -r, --remote HOST:PORT  Remote TCP connection
  -p, --pid PID           Target process ID
  -s, --socket PATH       Custom UDS socket path
  -t, --token TOKEN       Authentication token
  -c, --command CMD       Execute single command and exit
  -d, --discover          Discover running Log instances
  -h, --help              Show this help
